business.title: About Lorenzoz Agency
paragraphs: Lorenzoz Agency builds solutions for local businesses of any size, and what we sell is one outcome: new customers. Everything rests on a single core offer, Local SEO, which works on four fronts at once: authority content, backlinks and citations, authority on Google and in AI answers, and review management.

Around that core sit three optional services, each available on its own or alongside Local SEO: website development, an AI voice receptionist and software development. We are registered in Xinzo de Limia (Ourense, Spain) and work online with clients worldwide, with a focus on Australia, Canada, Costa Rica, Ireland, New Zealand, Spain, the United Kingdom and the United States. The division of labour is simple: the client focuses on delivering their own service well, and we take care of winning their customers and following them up.

business.title: About Masajes Orisha
paragraphs: Masajes Orisha is a therapeutic massage studio in San Rafael de Heredia, Costa Rica, led by its founder and therapist, Sergio Zaldívar Guillén. It offers relaxing, deep tissue, hot stone and aromatherapy massage, in sessions of 60 to 90 minutes that combine manual technique with natural oils.

The approach is unhurried: pressure and rhythm adapt to each person, with no rigid protocols. Sessions take place in a private studio, in a soundproof room with dimmable light, one client at a time. The name is inspired by the Yoruba Orishas, taken as a philosophy of respect for the body.

masajes-orisha-added-to-portfolio.title: Masajes Orisha joins the portfolio
masajes-orisha-added-to-portfolio.description: The website of Masajes Orisha, a therapeutic massage studio in San Rafael de Heredia, Costa Rica, now has its own case study in our portfolio.
paragraphs: Masajes Orisha, the website we built for a therapeutic massage studio in San Rafael de Heredia, Costa Rica, now has its own case study in our portfolio. The site is already live at masajesorisha.com.

It is the production build of the massage studio concept that also appears in the portfolio as a demo: bilingual in Spanish and English throughout, with a light and a dark theme that keep the same calm, editorial character.

Visitors choose from a short menu of four signature treatments, filtered in one tap, each card showing its duration and its focus. The booking request takes four steps (treatment, duration, day and time) and shows a running estimate before it is sent. There is no account and no payment gateway: the therapist confirms each request by email.
The site also carries a journal of long form pieces on manual therapy, the physiology of rest and muscle recovery, published in both languages.
The case study walks through the design, the treatment menu, the booking flow and the journal, with screenshots of each section.

gerp-dj-added-to-portfolio.title: GERP DJ joins the portfolio
gerp-dj-added-to-portfolio.description: The website of GERP DJ, a party, wedding and event DJ based in Ourense, Galicia, now has its own case study in our portfolio.
paragraphs: GERP DJ, a DJ for parties, weddings and events based in Ourense and available across Galicia, now has its own case study in our portfolio. The site we developed is already live and carries our credit in its footer.

It is published in Spanish and Galician, with a language switch in the header, and offers a light and a dark theme. The home opens on a background video that visitors can pause, followed by the four services: village festivals, weddings, private parties and company events.

Asking for a date takes three details: the day, the town and the type of event. The form then opens WhatsApp with the request already written and ready to send, with no server form in between. The booking page offers a fuller version of that request next to a set of frequently asked questions.

A gallery of ten captioned video clips, recorded at their performances and with their own equipment, shows what a celebration with GERP DJ looks like, and the booking page offers a press dossier to download as a PDF in Spanish and in Galician. The cookie policy states that the site uses no analytics or advertising cookies.

Measured with PageSpeed Insights on mobile on November 24, 2026, the home page scored 99 for Performance and 100 for Accessibility, Best Practices and SEO. The same day, Google's Rich Results Test found valid Breadcrumbs, Local business and Organisation structured data on the home page, which makes it eligible for rich results in Google Search. The case study shows both reports and walks through the design, the date request, the gallery and the bio, with screenshots of each.
